name: [SUNG JIN WOO] Multiversal Battlegrounds
desc:
A battlegrounds game with 40+ anime characters. Previously known as Sukuna Battlegrounds.

📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE) 
⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

🖥️ Controls
F - block
Q - dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Hold W - run
Left Click - punch
B - emote wheel

Credit: God, MChenL, FMRO
